content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The denial is for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge does not permit retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or sending more records would not cure CO-197; billing the patient would also be inappropriate absent established contractual patient liability. Human specialist review is the only available action that can properly assess any plan-specific exception or further appeal rights."}
